title: Adaptive pin and performance annotator: onboarding + docs update
creator: Avery Lin
description:
Goal: introduce an 'Adaptive Pin Annotator' that automatically recommends a stable pin for newly ingested model variants and publishes a lightweight performance annotation in the catalog docs. This work covers runtime heuristics for pin selection, metadata schema extension, publishing playbook updates, and developer-facing docs so product/solutions teams can rely on deterministic versioning and performance signatures for rollout decisions.

Why now: onboarding velocity for community/open variants has increased and manual pin decisions are a recurring bottleneck. We need a reproducible, auditable recommendation pipeline that combines perf fingerprints, delta-hash, and synthetic eval heuristics and emits a human-reviewable pin suggestion plus a performance annotation to drive console search/routing and release notes.
acceptance_criteria: New metadata field 'pin_recommendation' present in manifest for all newly onboarded variants
Automated annotator runs as part of ingest CI and produces a short perf_summary string (latency@p50,p95, token-cost-estimate)
Catalog UI surfaces the recommendation and perf_summary in the model detail page (dev console mock available)
Docs updated with step-by-step playbook for 'review -> approve pin -> publish' and links to PR checklist
End-to-end tests validating annotator output shape and that pin_recommendation is immutable after manual signoff
implementation_notes: Annotator lives in ingest pipeline (ingest-service/annotator) and runs post-manifest-generation
Heuristics: prefer lowest-delta-hash variant with perf fingerprint within 5% of top performer; flag high variance for manual review
Perf_summary generated from synthetic-benchmark job (small sample) + extrapolated token-cost model; store as compact string for catalog search
Emit audit event to catalog-audit-topic with reason, score, and upstream artifacts (benchrun id, manifest sha)
Add manifest schema v3 field 'pin_recommendation' and 'perf_summary' (both strings) and bump ingest contract
rollout_plan: Phase 1: feature-flagged deploy to staging; run annotator on nightly sample of new ingest jobs and surface outputs to internal docs (no pins written)
Phase 2: opt-in write mode for a small set of trusted models (canary); create PR automation to propose catalog updates without publishing pin until manual signoff
Phase 3: enable write mode for all non-critical public models with a 24h human audit window; monitor canary metrics for pin churn and false positives
Rollback: disable write-mode and revert recent catalog commits via atomic manifest rollback script if we observe >3% mis-pins or throughput regressions
test_plan: Unit tests for annotator scoring logic with synthetic fingerprints and delta-hash scenarios
Integration test: ingest-service -> annotator -> manifest store; assert fields set and audit event emitted
E2E: deploy to staging with feature flag; run a batch ingest of 10 community models and confirm UI surface and docs link generation
Canary alerting: baseline p50/p95 latency and token-cost delta; create SLO alerts in Datadog for abnormal pin frequency
